integrity: The mathematical proof and reproducer are provided; same-model review only, without independent audit or validation.
scientific_limitations: Proves the modulus p cubed for all odd primes in Z[X]; does not assert the modulus p to the fourth or cover p=2.
Relies on proved, explicitly cited finite binomial identities in Guo (2014), whose statements and proofs were inspected.
Historical priority is conditional on surveyed literature; an unindexed earlier proof cannot be excluded.
Finite machine checks are corroboration, not an all-prime proof.
title: The cubic-modulus Delannoy fourth-power congruence in the polynomial ring
